column3: Passenger side door is slightly off (looks like someone tried to pry it open).
Passenger side door latch is not working from the inside. I heard loose parts.
Driver side door (upholstery needs to be addressed seems loose).
Right headlight is dim (wonder if there is a loose wire from the work under hood).
Wiring cover in hood needs to be reattached.
Clutch and shifter seem to be failing. When I push in clutch if feels as if it is partially engaging. Matt is working the issue on his dime. Nice. In progress...
Driver side window "cushion" is loose needs glue. Fixed with JB Weld.
Driverside speaker cover is loose. Went to Car Toys and they tried to pop it back in place worked, but still pops off. I will JB Weld it.
Top latch is working intermittently. Needs to be adjusted. Screw is loose needs replacement or JB Weld.
Need to set the miles for tune up, oil change, valve adjustments, and break inspection
Driver side tire seems to collect more carbon from breaks.
Windshield wipers seem a bit delicate to operate.
Passenger window is stuck. Matt is ordering parts.
Trunk latch is sticking. There is a workaround to open it.
Gas tank has potential leak, gas is eroding the paint at the spout.
